Francisco Gold Condominium II, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City Telephone Number 925.11.48 • 925.88.88 • 925.03.32 www.dile.gov.ph LEGAL SERVICE b, NÉNG- 09 MAY 2013 HON. DIOSDADO G. PALLASIGUE DILG Legal Opinion No. 17 S. 2013 MAYOR Isulan, Sultan Kudarat Dear Mayor Pallasigue: This refers to your letter dated February 19, 2013 seeking legal opinion on the following issues, to wit: l. Whether or not the Sangguniang Bayan's act of declaring vacant the chairmanship of the Committee on Finance, Budget Appropriations and Ways & Means and the election of its new chairman at the start of the ensuing fiscal year, despite its failure to pass the annual appropriations ordinance, violative of Section 323 of RA 7160, also known as the Local Government Code of 1991 '? 2. What is the scope of the phrase "no other business" in Section 323 of the 'Local Government Code of 1991'? Is the reorganization of the standing committee considered a 'Cbusiness" under its purview that is prohibited from being taken up? According to your letter, you are raising the above quoted queries in order to clarify the two (2) seemingly conflicting legal opinions rendered by the Department of the Interior and Local Government Regional Office No. XII because while the first opinion dated January 14, 2013 declared as irregular and improper the act of the Sangguniang Bayan of Isulan, Sultan Kudarat in replacing the Chairman of the Committee on Finance, Budget and Ways & Means after it failed to approve the Annual Budget of that municipality, the subsequent February 4, 2013 opinion of the same Office this time already stated that such action taken by that Sanggunian"subsists" provided it is within the bounds of their Internal Rules. You likewise stated therein that pending the resolution of this issue, you have deferred the attendance Of your Department Heads to the sessions of the present Committee. Further, you advanced your contention that the first opinion should be upheld. In this regard, please be informed that this level is of the view that the Regional Office, after issuing the January 14, 2013 opinion, has decided to overturn and overrule itself by issuing the subsequent February 4, 2013 opinion. As such, this level sees no conflicting opinions from the Regional Office, only an overturning of a previous opinion. Thusly, insofar as the Regional Office is concerned, their prevailing opinion is the one contained in its February 4, 2013 opinion. It's more fun in the Phi!

-2- What is in conflict now is the present Chairmanship of the Committee on Finance, Budget and Ways & Means and your own opinion that the replacement is not proper citing as your basis Section 323 of the Local Government Code, as in fact you have deferred the attendance of your Department Heads to the sessions of the present Committee. Accordingly, considering the fact that what is involved here are conflicting claims on an act of a Sanggunian Bayan as well as taking into consideration the mandate of DILG Memorandum Order No. 2010-02 not to act on justiciable issues such as what is involved here, this Department is constrained to refrain from answering your queries and from rendering any opinion on the legality or validity of such replacement of the Chairman of the Committee on Finance, Budget and Ways & Means. As such, if you are not in accord with the action of the Sanggunian Bayan in replacing the Chairman of its Committee on Finance, Budget and Ways & Means, you should file the proper case with the courts of justice which has the authority to rule on the validity or invalidity thereo€ Pending the ruling of the courts in this issue, it would appear that such action of the Sanggunian enjoys, in the meantime only, the presumption of validity, absence any court declaration otherwise. For your appropriate action. Very truly yours, SUS Dir LS:19/11 Dir. Reynaldo Bungubung OIC Regional Director DII.G xn, Cotabato City o tor 1
